notes.title: Ukrainian translation added
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I’m just writing a quick post to let you know that I’ve uploaded a shiny new build of Six Days of Snow! This build adds a Ukrainian translation to the game, which was very kindly done by AleksaPsi, with editing and correcting by MaryLDevis and Lacki23!

I’m very happy to share more of my stories with more people! I hope you enjoy the visual novel, and please give your thanks to the talented translators who worked on this for me. I couldn’t have done it without them!

- ebi x

notes.title: Chinese translation
notes.content:
I'm posting a quick update to let you know that Six Days of Snow has been translated into Chinese, thanks to Molchunya. This latest update adds a full translation, and also fixes a few spelling errors that were present in the English script. I hope you all enjoy it!

- ebi x

notes.title: All Ashes and Illusions released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm writing an announcement to let you know that my newest VN, All Ashes and Illusions, has been released on Steam!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024327/190eeea69ee5b3911ea251da9cc0f7b4e523e3cc.png

Ashes is a fairly grim 'romance' story about a delusional young prince who falls obsessively in love with his childhood nursemaid, Safiya.

Ashes features content some people might find discomforting, such as: a relationship with a 20 year age difference (Yuel, the protagonist and delusional young prince, is 20, while Safiya, his nursemaid and love interest, is 41), dub/noncon, written depictions of violence, coarse language, and a lot of casual misogyny.

Ashes is quite a painful read, but it's one of my favourite stories I've written to date, and I'm very fond of the characters. Do consider checking it out, if you're after a VN with an older love interest, and you don't mind a hefty dose of Despair and Suffering! I'd be very interested to hear what people make of this story (and Yuel, in particular), and whether it succeeds in ousting Sweetest Monster from its position of 'The Most Unpleasant ebi Story to Date'!

If you enjoyed some of my grimmer stories that tackle unsettling subject matter, such as the aforementioned Sweetest Monster, The Mermaid of Zennor, or Six Days of Snow, it might be worth checking out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020

- ebi x

notes.title: The End of an Actress released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I just thought I'd let you know that my newest VN, The End of an Actress, has been released on Steam!
It's a tragic romance story based loosely on the life (and death) of Marie Antoinette. It has a few different endings, but none of them are particularly cheerful.

It's a depressing 'romance story', similar to Six Days of Snow, that ends poorly regardless of what you choose... though I think it's less discomforting than Snow, as the lead characters in Actress are at least much closer in age.

If you're interested, I hope you consider checking it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147760/The_End_of_an_Actress/

Thank you very much!

- ebi x

notes.title: A Winter's Daydream released on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I thought I'd let you know that my latest visual novel, A Winter's Daydream, has been released on Steam!
A Winter's Daydream is a cute story about an elderly grandmother who magically transforms into a young girl! Wacky anime hijinks ensue.

A Winter's Daydream has a similar setting to Six Days of Snow (the snowy Japanese countryside), and though it is quite silly, it does have some more sombre/serious moments. Despite the drastically different plots, I think these two stories are aesthetically rather similar, and if you enjoyed one you may enjoy the other.

The story can be found here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/925340/A_Winters_Daydream/

Thank you for your time!

- ebi x
